mapper.sql: select result_id, resource_id, resource_title, risk_score, duplicate_score, compliance_level, hit_words, suggestion, audit_summary, status, raw_result, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_audit_result
mapper.select: and resource_id = #{resourceId}and resource_title like concat('%', #{resourceTitle}, '%')and compliance_level = #{complianceLevel}and status = #{status} order by result_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_audit_result(resource_id, resource_title, risk_score, duplicate_score, compliance_level, hit_words, suggestion, audit_summary, status, raw_result, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{resourceId}, #{resourceTitle}, #{riskScore}, #{duplicateScore}, #{complianceLevel}, #{hitWords}, #{suggestion}, #{auditSummary}, #{status}, #{rawResult}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update ai_audit_result set resource_title=#{resourceTitle}, risk_score=#{riskScore}, duplicate_score=#{duplicateScore}, compliance_level=#{complianceLevel}, hit_words=#{hitWords}, suggestion=#{suggestion}, audit_summary=#{auditSummary}, status=#{status}, raw_result=#{rawResult}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate(), remark=#{remark} where result_id=#{resultId}
mapper.delete: delete from ai_audit_result where result_id in #{resultId}
